name: Capacitor Production Line Solutions
summary: Turnkey automation solutions for capacitor manufacturers, covering winding, assembly, sealing, aging, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The capacitor production line solution is a turnkey automation solution provided by TXAM for capacitor manufacturers.

Solution Components

The entire line covers the full process including winding, assembly, impregnation, sealing, aging testing, visual inspection, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • High-speed precision winding, achieving industry-leading winding accuracy
  • Automated assembly, reducing manual intervention and improving consistency
  • Vacuum impregnation system, ensuring stable insulation performance
  • Intelligent aging testing, significantly improving testing efficiency
  • Visual inspection system, high defect recognition accuracy
  • Moisture-proof packaging system, ensuring product storage life

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
